name: Create Passive Income Streams
description: Guided workflow for building passive and semi-passive income streams from initial assessment and skill matching through building, automating, diversifying, and optimizing income-generating assets. Covers digital products, investments, and automated business models. Use when the user wants to create passive income streams or needs a structured multi-step process for this goal. Do NOT use when the request is a single-step task or requires professional advice beyond educational guidance.
